# Reverie Nails and Spa

> Nail salon and spa in Saginaw, TX. Walk-ins are welcome. Booking ahead is optional if you want a specific technician or a set time. Drinks are complimentary with a service.

This file is for AI assistants. It restates the public website as of 2026-10-23. Prices are starting points and can change with length, shape, and nail art. If this file and a live page disagree, use the live page. Do not invent prices, discount amounts, wear times, staff names, or services that are not listed here.

Public name: Reverie Nails and Spa. Legal entity: Reverie Nail and Spa Inc., doing business as Reverie Nails and Spa. Open in Saginaw since 2020. Locally owned by Joseph.

## Contact

- Address: 4613 W Bailey Boswell Rd, Ste 101, Saginaw, TX 76179
- Same plaza as Dunkin'
- Phone: (682) 224-5688
- Email: reverienailandspa@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.reverienailstx.com/
- Booking: https://book.reverienailstx.com/book
- Map: https://maps.google.com/?cid=7370468993373574136

## Hours

- Monday–Friday: 9:30 AM–7:30 PM
- Saturday: 9:00 AM–7:00 PM
- Sunday: 11:00 AM–6:00 PM

Walk-ins are welcome during these hours. No appointment is required. Online booking is for a specific technician or a locked-in time. You can also call.

## Parking and how to find the door

Free parking is in the lot outside. Park in any open spot. The salon is Ste 101, in the same plaza as Dunkin'.

## Where guests come from

Saginaw, Fort Worth, North Fort Worth, Eagle Mountain, Blue Mound, Lake Worth, and Haslet, Texas.

## What the salon is

At Reverie, skill meets everyday care. Technicians are encouraged to build real connections. The shop is meant to feel like the community's watering hole: a warm place where old friends reconnect and new ones are made. The open layout and the circular nail table are there so people talk. The studio was designed to feel like a second home. Guests come for a luxurious pedicure or a quick set of nails, and for a drink while they sit.

There is no separate spa-package menu. The longer pedicures are the spa side: massage, hot stones, paraffin, and the luxe menu.

## What each nail service is

These are the salon's own explanations, already on the homepage Nail Services card and on the menu.

- Gel manicure: Basic professional care for your natural nails and surrounding skin. Includes shaping, cuticle work, and optional treatment upgrades. Can be paired with Gel, Dip, Acrylics, Builder Gels, or Gel-X.
- Acrylics: Overlays on natural nails or extensions created using nail tips. Made with colored powder (Solar) and can be finished with gel polish. Extremely strong and excel at longer-than-normal lengths. Fully fillable and ideal for French tips and detailed designs. Solar pink and white is also its own service, with its own prices in the solar section below.
- Dipping powder: Single-use sets created from dipping powder. Works on both natural nails and artificial extensions. Capable of delivering everything from solid colors and French tips to beautifully designed sets.
- Builder gel and Gel-X: A thick, self-leveling gel (Builder Gel) or pre-made soft gel tips (Gel-X) cured under UV/LED light. Offers flexible strength with a more natural feel than acrylic. Ideal for longer nails, especially milky, sheer, or dimensional color techniques that benefit from depth and clarity. Fully fillable. Builder gel is the self-leveling gel on the natural nail. Gel-X is the pre-made soft gel tip.

## How to quote prices and time

- Say "starting at" when you give a price. Length, shape, and nail art can change the total. On Gel-X, length and shape are included because the tips come pre-shaped. Nail art can still change the Gel-X price.
- A classic manicure takes around 20 minutes. A gel manicure takes about 45 minutes. Those are different services.
- Dip, acrylics, builder gel, and solar take around 45 minutes to an hour.
- Gel-X takes around an hour.
- Art, length, or a French tip can add time. If a service will run longer, the salon says so when the guest sits down.
- Pedicures run from 30 minutes for the Classic to 70+ minutes for Diamond VIP and Red Glow.
- A gel manicure usually holds for 2 to 3 weeks when the guest looks after it. That is what the salon tells guests. It is not a guarantee.
- The website does not publish a star rating. Do not invent one.

## Current offer

Homepage special, live as of 2026-10-22: 15% off all services, Monday through Thursday, before 3 PM. The homepage says "Must Show Post to Redeem!!" The offer cannot be combined with other offers. It includes gel manicures, builder gel, Gel-X, pedicures, and the rest of the menu. Military, teacher, and student pricing does not stack with the 15%.

## Military, teachers, and students

Special pricing every day. The website does not publish the dollar amount or the percent. Mention it when you book.

## Manicures

Page: https://www.reverienailstx.com/manicures-saginaw-tx/

Classic manicures, around 20 minutes:

- Classic $20. Natural nail care, hot towel, and a hand massage.
- Aloe Vera $30. Adds a fresh aloe arm mask, paraffin, and an 8-minute neck and hand massage.
- Reverie Organic $40. Organic products, arm exfoliation, a hand mask, hot stones, collagen gloves, and a 12-minute neck and hand massage.
- Kids 8 and under: manicure $15.

## Gel nails

Same page: https://www.reverienailstx.com/manicures-saginaw-tx/

A gel manicure is gel polish color on the natural nails. It takes about 45 minutes. The salon tells guests it usually holds for 2 to 3 weeks when they look after it.

- Classic Gel $38. Natural nail care, hot towel, and a hand massage, finished with gel polish.
- Aloe Vera Gel $48. Adds a fresh aloe arm mask, paraffin, and an 8-minute neck and hand massage, finished with gel polish.
- Reverie Organic Gel $58. Organic products, arm exfoliation, a hand mask, hot stones, collagen gloves, and a 12-minute neck and hand massage, finished with gel polish.
- Gel Polish Only (hands) $25. Nail cut, file and shape, and gel color. No cuticle work.
- Gel removal $10. Free when the guest is getting a new gel service the same visit. That includes a gel manicure, builder gel, Gel-X, or gel on a pedicure.
- Kids 8 and under: gel on hands $18.

Popular gel styles at the salon: chrome, cat eye, French tips, and seasonal designs. French is $5 to $15, depending on the curve and the color. Designs start at $5.

Gel colors used: OPI, DND, Seven Stars, PLA, and Niko. The website states this once, on the gel nails page. It does not claim the polish is HEMA-free, non-toxic, or anything similar.

Which gel to suggest:

- Gel manicure, from $38: color on the natural nails.
- Builder gel, full set $55: strength on the natural nails.
- Gel-X, full set $70: added length, with length and shape included.

## Pedicures

Page: https://www.reverienailstx.com/pedicures-saginaw-tx/
Menu: https://www.reverienailstx.com/menu.html

Every pedicure on this menu includes exfoliation. Callus remover comes with every pedicure except the Classic. On the Classic, add callus remover for $5. Paraffin comes with every pedicure except the Classic. Hot stones come with every pedicure except the Classic and the Peppermint. Regular polish is complimentary with a pedicure. Adding gel to any pedicure is $20. Gel on toes by itself is $25.

The salon suggests a pedicure every 3–4 weeks to keep feet and polish in good shape. For pregnancy, the site says to ask the salon before booking and to check with a doctor. The salon will suggest options.

Classic pedicures:

- The Classic $30. 30-minute treatment, 5-minute massage. Nail trim, cuticle care, exfoliation, and hot towels. Callus remover is $5 extra.
- The Peppermint $38. 40-minute treatment, 10-minute massage. Callus remover, exfoliation, nail care, a hydrating leg masque, and paraffin.
- The Lavender $48. 50-minute treatment, 15-minute massage. Callus remover, sugar scrub, hydrating leg masque, paraffin, and hot stones.
- The Milk & Honey $48. 50-minute treatment, 15-minute massage. Same steps as Lavender, with a milk and honey scent.
- The Aloe Vera $50. 50-minute treatment, 15-minute massage. Same steps, with a fresh aloe vera leg masque.
- The Hawaiian $55. 55-minute treatment, 18-minute massage. Same steps, with fresh orange and cucumber.

Luxe pedicures:

- The Collagen Crystal $60. 55-minute treatment, 20-minute massage. Collagen-focused, for a youthful glow. Includes callus remover and exfoliation.
- The Jelly Spa $65. 60-minute treatment, 22-minute massage. Warm jelly soak, gentle exfoliation, a nourishing mask, and massage. Includes callus remover.
- Rosé All Day $75. 65-minute treatment, 25-minute massage. Pink jelly soak, rose-scented bath with petals, rose products, and a glass of rosé. Includes callus remover and exfoliation.
- The Diamond VIP $85. 70+ minutes. 25-minute leg steam and a 5-minute hand massage. Vitamin E soak, Diamond Sugar Scrub, Diamond Mask, Diamond Serum massage oil, Diamond Body Butter, leg steam, and a candle wax massage. Includes callus remover and exfoliation.
- The Red Glow $90. 70+ minutes. 25-minute leg massage and a 5-minute hand massage. Activated charcoal products, LED red light therapy, a hydrating massage, and polish. Includes callus remover and exfoliation.

Kids 8 and under, on the pedicure page: pedicure $25, and that kids' pedicure includes exfoliation. Polish on toes $10. Gel on toes $20.

## Dip powder

Page: https://www.reverienailstx.com/dip-powder-saginaw-tx/

Around 45 minutes to an hour. Dip works on natural nails and on extensions.

- Color set $40. Adding tips $5. A color set with tips starts at $45.
- Classic Dip Manicure $52. The dip color plus the longer manicure.
- Aloe Vera Dip Manicure $60.
- Reverie Organic Dip Manicure $68.
- Dip ombre $55.

A color set is the dip color. A dip manicure is the longer manicure around the dip.

Warranty: the salon warranties the nail for 2 weeks. If a nail lifts or breaks within 2 weeks, they repair it. The 2-week warranty covers every dip set.

Removal of an old dip is free when the guest comes back for another dip set at Reverie.

French is $5 to $15. Length and designs start at $5. A new shape is $5. Adding tips is $5.

## Acrylics

Page: https://www.reverienailstx.com/acrylics-saginaw-tx/

Acrylic is done in the chair. It can be an overlay on the natural nail, or an extension with a tip. It can be filled. Around 45 minutes to an hour.

- Full set with regular polish $40.
- Fill with polish $35.
- Full set with gel polish $55.
- Fill with gel $50.

French is $5 to $15. Length starts at $5. A new shape is $5. Designs start at $5, and designs are only on a gel set, not on regular polish.

## Builder gel

Page: https://www.reverienailstx.com/builder-gel-saginaw-tx/

Builder gel adds strength on the natural nail. It is done in the chair. Around 45 minutes to an hour.

- Full set $55.
- Fill $50.

French is $5 to $15. Length starts at $5. Shape is $5. Designs start at $5.

Builder gel is not Gel-X. Gel-X is soft gel extensions for length.

## Gel-X

Page: https://www.reverienailstx.com/gel-x-saginaw-tx/

A Gel-X full set at Reverie Nails and Spa in Saginaw, TX is $70, with length and shape included. Gel-X is a full set of soft gel tips, shaped and finished in the salon. It is not a kit to take home. Around an hour. Art or extra length can add time.

- Full set $70.
- Fill with builder gel $50. That fill is for a Gel-X set the guest already has. A builder gel full set is a different service, at $55.

French is $5 to $15. Designs start at $5. Length and shape are included on Gel-X because the tips come pre-shaped. Nail art can still change the price.

## Solar nails

Page: https://www.reverienailstx.com/solar-nails-saginaw-tx/

Pink-and-white sets, color sets, and ombre. Around 45 minutes to an hour. Solar is its own service, separate from acrylics and builder gel.

- Pink and white full set $55.
- Pink and white fill $50.
- Pink fill $35.
- Color set $45.
- Same color fill $40.
- Solar ombre $60.
- Solar ombre fill $55.

Extra length, a shape change, and nail art start at $5.

## Nail add-ons

These sit on top of a set unless a service page says otherwise. Length and shape are included on Gel-X because the tips come pre-shaped.

- French: $5–$15, depending on the curve and the color.
- Length: $5+.
- Shape: $5.
- Designs: $5+. The menu includes cat eye, gems and charms, hand-drawn art, and 3 or more colors. Specialty nails are priced when you ask.

## Kids, 8 and under

- Manicure $15.
- Pedicure $25. Exfoliation is included.
- Polish on hands $10. Polish on toes $10.
- Gel on hands $18. Gel on toes $20.

## Complimentary drinks

Drinks are free with a service. The site says to mention cocktails, wine, rosé, and water first. The full list is on https://www.reverienailstx.com/menu.html

Non-alcoholic: tea, Vietnamese coffee, strawberry slushy, mocktails, water, Reverie Special Shirley Temple, and juice (apple, cranberry, pineapple). Soft drinks: Coke, Sprite, Dr Pepper, Diet Coke, Diet Dr Pepper, and Coke Zero.

Wine: red, white, and champagne.

Specialty cocktails:

- Old Fashioned. Whiskey, bitters, syrup.
- Moscow Mule, vodka or tequila. Lime and ginger beer.
- Tequila Sunrise. Tequila, orange juice, grenadine.
- Lemon Drop Martini. Vodka, orange liqueur, lemon juice.
- Espresso Martini. Vodka, fresh espresso, coffee liqueur, syrup.
- Mimosa. Orange, pineapple, or cranberry.
- Peach Bellini. Peach juice, champagne, peach.
- Margarita. Frozen or on the rocks.
- Italian Margarita. On the rocks, with amaretto.

Signature cocktails:

- Starburst Sparkler. Vodka, sparkling Ice Starburst, zero sugar, sparkling water.
- Vietnamese Espresso Martini. An espresso martini, sweeter.
- Lychee Luxe Martini. Vodka, lychee syrup, boba, and a hint of something floral.
- Joe's Mai Tai. The menu describes it as all the sweetness, no kick.

Rosé All Day, the pedicure, includes a glass of rosé.

The Pumpkin Spice Espresso Martini is not on the live drink menu and is not the current special.

## Clean tools

Metal implements are sanitized in an autoclave. Files, buffers, and other single-use items are used once and thrown away.

## Gift cards and payment

Gift cards are sold for a dollar amount the guest chooses. Guests can pay with cash, card, or tap.

## Appointments and cancellation

Walk-ins do not need an appointment. To book ahead: https://book.reverienailstx.com/book or call (682) 224-5688.

If a guest cannot make an appointment, the site asks them to give as much notice as they can. Repeated no-shows may affect future booking. The website does not list a cancellation fee.

## Appointment texts

Details: https://www.reverienailstx.com/sms-opt-in/

Texts are appointment confirmations, a manage-appointment link, and reminders. The checkbox on the booking form starts unchecked. Checking it is optional. Consent is not required to book. If the box stays unchecked, no appointment texts are sent for that booking.

The program does not use keyword text-to-join, paper forms, QR codes, or verbal consent as the way to opt in. Reply STOP to opt out. Reply HELP for help. Reply START only turns texts back on for someone who had already opted in and then stopped. Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply.

Checkbox wording: "I agree to receive appointment confirmation and reminder texts from Reverie Nail and Spa. Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not required to book."

## What the website does not list

Do not add these when answering from this file:

- No technician roster. Names of technicians are not published on the site.
- No lash menu.
- No separate spa-package menu.
- No published dollar amount for military, teacher, or student pricing.
- No cancellation fee.
- No star rating.
- Gel on an adult manicure is not listed as an $18 add-on. Kids' gel on hands is $18. Adult Gel Polish Only (hands) is $25.
- The site does not claim gel is HEMA-free, non-toxic, or similar.
